title: Microsoft Security Operations Analyst (SC-200)
subtitle: Trening za SC-200 po ciljevima ispita od 21. 10. 2026: Microsoft Sentinel (SIEM, data lake, analytics, automatizacija), Defender XDR i Defender for Endpoint, Purview istrage i threat hunting u KQL-u, sa KQL labovima nad Microsoftovim primjerima podataka, bez interneta.

exam.note: Pravi SC-200 ima oko 40–60 pitanja (višestruki izbor, studije slučaja, drag-and-drop), traje 100 minuta, prolaz je 700/1000; certifikat važi godinu dana i obnavlja se besplatnom online procjenom. KQL se na ispitu čita i dopunjava, ne izvršava.
exam.note_en: The real SC-200 has about 40–60 questions (multiple choice, case studies, drag-and-drop), lasts 100 minutes, and the passing score is 700/1000; the certification is valid for one year and is renewed through a free online assessment. On the exam, KQL is read and completed, not executed.
